description: Minimized genuine public ESPN team API captures for issue #166. Every retained value is copied unchanged from the named source; nothing is synthetic. Tests that need a variation construct it in the test and label it SYNTHETIC there.
captured: 2026-10-19 (UTC), ordinary public team schedule and statistics responses fetched by the coordinator with local curl; see sourceTimestamp per file.
generator: prepare-fixtures.mjs (operational, outside the repository): node prepare-fixtures.mjs <inputDir> <repoDir>

minimization.schedule: Kept timestamp, status, season, requestedSeason; team id/abbreviation/location/name/displayName/logo/recordSummary; per event id, date, name, shortName, season, seasonType, week, timeValid and competitions[] with id, date, timeValid, neutralSite, status, broadcasts[].media.shortName, competitors[] id/homeAway/winner/score and team id/location/nickname/abbreviation/displayName/shortDisplayName plus only the logo whose rel includes "default". Dropped leaders, links, venue, notes, per-competitor records and rankings, tickets and other unread fields.
minimization.statistics: Kept status, season, requestedSeason, team (as above), and the complete passing, rushing and scoring categories of results.stats.categories and results.opponent. Other categories dropped.
